evidence_after.text: Weiss et al. (2018) propose a connection between long short- term memory networks (LSTMs) and counter au- tomata. They provide a construction by which the LSTM can simulate a simpliﬁed variant of a counter automaton. They also demonstrate that LSTMs can learn to increment and decrement their cell state as counters in practice.
